seo.title: Caique Nonato da Silva | Front-end Developer — Angular & Ionic
seo.description: Portfolio of Caique Nonato da Silva — Front-end developer (Angular, Ionic, TypeScript) with 5+ years building mobile-first ERP modules at Exclusiva. Projects, stack and resume at caiquenonato.com.br.
hero.name: Caique Nonato da Silva
hero.bio: Front-end developer at Exclusiva, building mobile-first internal ERP modules with Angular, Ionic, Capacitor and TypeScript — from requirements to production.
sobre.title: About me
sobre.p1: At Exclusiva, I'm the front-end reference for the internal ERP: I turn business rules into mobile-first screens with Angular, Ionic, Capacitor, TypeScript, Angular Material and Chart.js, from requirements gathering to production delivery.
sobre.p2: My work covers sales/POS, campaigns, field supervision, HR, security and permissions, finance and e-commerce UX. Previously, as IT Coordinator at the same company, I coordinated L1–L3 support and operations with GLPI, Zabbix and Active Directory.
sobre.studying: Currently studying: Docker, Node.js and C# — expanding my toolkit to connect front-end apps to APIs and backend services.
